title: Laser plasma as explanation for the Tic Tac
place_text: off the coast of San Diego

tellings.quote:
>> Yes, it would from a kinematic point of
view. But the visuals don't line up.

plain: One idea is that the Tic Tac, a white oval object shaped like the mint that Navy pilots reported off San Diego in 2004, was a glowing ball of plasma made by lasers. A former NSA official named Eric Haseltine weighs the idea with Michels. He says it works "from a kinematic point of view," meaning it could explain how the object seemed to move, "but the visuals don't line up" with what the pilots described.
